property.name: start
property.description-key: start of the gantt chart boundary, leave blank to use the earliest task date

property.name: end
property.description-key: end of the gantt chart boundary, leave blank to use the latest task date

property.name: idField
property.description-key: Field name used for the task ID.

property.name: titleField
property.description-key: Field name used for the task title. Use lookup.column (e.g. resource.name) for a column on a related table; this works in every field setting.

property.name: startField
property.description-key: Field name used for the task start date.

property.name: endField
property.description-key: Field name used for the task end date.

property.name: progressField
property.description-key: Field name used for task progress (0-100).

property.name: parentField
property.description-key: Field name used for a parent task relationship. Matched against the record id, then the task title.

property.name: rowField
property.description-key: Optional field name. With Group rows on, records sharing the same value are drawn as separate bars on one row, labelled with that value (for example, every roster swing for an employee).

property.name: rowTitleField
property.description-key: Optional field name used to label a grouped row, so rows can be grouped by one value (e.g. employee.id) and shown by another (e.g. employee.name). Falls back to the Row field value.

property.name: categoryField
property.description-key: Optional field name used to group tasks; shown in the tooltip.

property.name: colorField
property.description-key: Optional field name whose value picks a bar's colour when Colour by is set to the colour field. Falls back to the Category field.

property.name: lockedField
property.description-key: Optional field name marking records that may not be rescheduled. A record whose value is true, yes or any non-zero number cannot be moved or resized, whatever Allow move and Allow resize say. Blank, false, no and 0 leave it editable.

property.name: density
property.description-key: Row density of the chart.

value.name: comfortable
value.description-key: Taller rows with start, finish and progress columns.

value.name: compact
value.description-key: Condensed rows that fit more tasks on screen.

property.name: timeScale
property.description-key: Initial zoom level of the timeline.

property.name: colorMode
property.description-key: What decides a bar's colour.

value.name: status
value.description-key: Built-in scheme: on track, at risk, overdue, complete or not started, derived from progress against elapsed time.

value.name: field
value.description-key: The Colour field's value on each record, coloured by the Colour legend or, when that is blank, by a palette handed out as values appear.

property.name: colorLegend
property.description-key: Your own colours and legend labels. JSON — [{"value":"Planned","label":"Planned work","color":"#0078D4"}] or {"Planned":"#0078D4"} — or shorthand, Planned=#0078D4; Active=#107C10. Use * for everything unmatched. With Colour by set to Status, entries named after a status (On track, At risk, Overdue, Complete, Not started) recolour and rename it.

property.name: showToolbar
property.description-key: Shows the command bar with search, density and zoom controls.

property.name: showCurrentTime
property.description-key: Shows a vertical marker for the current date.

property.name: groupRows
property.description-key: Draws records that share a Row field value as separate bars on one row. When off, every record gets its own row.

property.name: showProgress
property.description-key: Fills each bar in proportion to its progress value.

property.name: showLegend
property.description-key: Shows the colour legend along the bottom of the chart.

property.name: allowMove
property.description-key: Lets a user drag a bar along the timeline to reschedule it, keeping its duration. The control does not save the change: it publishes it through the Last edit property and your app writes it back.

property.name: allowResize
property.description-key: Lets a user drag either end of a bar to change when it starts or finishes. Published the same way as Allow move; a rolled-up parent bar is never resizable, as its span comes from its children.

property.name: selectedTaskId
property.description-key: The taskId of the bar the user selected. Empty while a row is selected.

property.name: selectedRowId
property.description-key: The row the user selected: the Row field value when rows are grouped, otherwise the taskId of the row. Empty while a bar is selected.

property.name: lastEdit
property.description-key: The last move or resize, as JSON: {"stamp":1,"action":"move","taskId":"T-1","title":"Mobilisation","start":"2026-09-20T09:00:00+08:00","end":"2026-09-27T17:00:00+08:00"}. Read it in OnChange with ParseJSON and switch on action. Stamp counts the edits, so repeating one — dragging a bar back where it was — still reaches OnChange. Blank until the first edit.
